hook: An AI agent just bought a pizza, no card needed.
hookText: First cardless AI purchase in the UK

beats.say: An AI agent has made a cardless purchase in the UK for the first time, ordering a pizza without a human entering any payment details.
The agent completed the purchase on its own, a first for the UK, and a sign of how far agentic shopping has come.
Cardless agent purchases raise new questions about who authorizes a payment when no human types in the card.
